text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Good morning! Did you have a good break?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I hung out a bunch with Sei!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We played with a kitty at the park, and took naps, and skipped stones at the pond, and took more naps…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It was suuuper nice! Now I feel amazing! Urara, la la la! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hanging out with Seiun Sky, it seems Haru Urara feels very relaxed.
